presentationContract.presentation: Unstyled Dialog compound primitives. Root manages dialog state; Popup and Backdrop supply behavior but no product positioning, backdrop color, size or surface styles.
presentationContract.composition: Root contains Trigger and either (a) Portal with explicitly styled Backdrop and Popup, or (b) AgentUIDialogContent, which owns its Portal and Backdrop. Do not wrap Content in an additional Portal.
presentationContract.portal: Portal targets the nearest AgentUIRoot portal container, preserving the Agent UI theme boundary; it does not center its children. No caller container override or separate document.body portal is needed.
presentationContract.interaction: Use the public Trigger/Close composition or documented focus props for trigger registration and focus restoration. Controlled open state alone does not register an arbitrary external button as the trigger. Verify Escape, close and focus return in the actual Host.
presentationContract.styles: Import @za38.03/agent-ui-plugins/styles.css for styled public controls. Raw Popup still needs project-owned scoped positioning and surface styles.
